summary: Frontend-only testing of Coming soon treatment, Indonesia->Bali rename/redirects, destination-only search, homepage Top 10/Europe tabs, Europe country filters, photo-uniqueness on 8 listing pages, mobile hamburger order, header 'Speak to a holiday expert' link, hero poster+collage, static assets (favicon/manifest/sitemap/robots/hero media), sitemap content and regression on key routes. Nearly all requirements pass; two minor UI/UX leftovers found (count-text format inconsistency on country-filtered Europe pages, and legacy /asia/indonesia href still present in one Bali trip-card anchor).

ui_bugs.issue: Hero/counter text shows 'Browse 1 package idea' instead of the expected 'N holidays' format used by Switzerland (4 holidays) and France (3 holidays). 4 trip cards are rendered on the page so the >0 result requirement is met, but counter wording is inconsistent across countries.
First anchor in listing points to legacy /asia/indonesia (which 301-redirects to /asia/bali/holidays). Should link directly to the Bali trip detail page instead of relying on the legacy redirect.

test_coverage_passed: Static assets 200: /favicon.ico, /favicon-32.png, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /apple-touch-icon.png, /manifest.json, /sitemap.xml (valid XML, contains /asia/bali/holidays, zero /asia/indonesia), /robots.txt (has Sitemap: line), /hero-poster.webp, /hero-video-360.mp4
Where to next? Top 10 tab shows exactly: Europe, Japan, Vietnam, Bali, Bhutan, Thailand, Singapore, China, Kazakhstan, Egypt (in order)
Middle East tab: Egypt renders as link (4 Egypt anchors), Jordan and UAE are rendered as data-testid='destination-card-coming-soon' with visible data-testid='coming-soon-tag' (2) and no <a>
Asia tab: Sri Lanka is coming-soon, Bali tile present, 0 Indonesia links

Europe tab: exactly 11 tiles with correct hrefs - Europe /europe, Italy /europe/italy, Switzerland /europe/holidays?country=Switzerland, France /europe/holidays?country=France, Greece /europe/greece, Norway /europe/norway, Germany /europe/holidays?country=Germany, Netherlands /europe/holidays?country=Netherlands, Ireland /europe/ireland, Finland /europe/finland, Sweden /europe/sweden

Hero search: all suggestion rows have data-kind='destination'; zero Northern Lights / Jordan / UAE / Sri Lanka rows; typing 'indonesia' returns only 'Bali'; clicking Bali navigates to /asia/bali/holidays

Desktop mega-menu (hover 'Destinations'): Middle East region shows menu-country-coming-soon for Jordan+UAE (2 tiles, 'Coming soon' tag). Asia region shows Sri Lanka as menu-country-coming-soon and Bali as /asia/bali anchor
/asia/bali/holidays: title='Bali tours & holidays | Hi Tours', H1='Bali tours & holidays', breadcrumb shows Bali

Bali trip detail (/asia/best-of-bali-with-ubud-and-kuta): loads with 0 pageerrors; breadcrumb 'Destinations > Asia > Bali > ...' with Bali linking to /asia/bali (2 anchors); 'Other Bali holidays you may like' section renders

eg-cr-mosaic photo uniqueness verified on all 8 listing pages (/asia/bali/holidays, /asia/japan/holidays, /asia/china/holidays, /europe/greece/holidays, /europe/norway/holidays, /europe/finland/holidays, /europe/sweden/holidays, /europe/ireland/holidays): 8 imgs each, 8 unique srcs each, all naturalWidth>0 after scroll-into-view
/europe/holidays?country=Switzerland shows '4 holidays' (7 cards); ?country=France shows '3 holidays' (6 cards); ?country=Germany shows 4 cards; ?country=Netherlands shows 4 cards (all >0)

Mobile 390x844 hamburger (data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle'): drawer items in correct order - Destinations, About us, Why Us?, Hi Tours cares, Speak to a holiday expert, Careers. Careers href='/careers'. No 'Press', no 'Work with us'
Desktop header right link reads 'Speak to a holiday expert' (3 instances)
Footer: contains Bali and Japan; no Sri Lanka, Maldives or Indonesia
action_items: LOW: Normalise the hero counter text on /europe/holidays?country=Germany and ?country=Netherlands to match the 'N holidays' pattern used by Switzerland/France (currently shows 'Browse 1 package idea').
LOW: Replace stale a[href='/asia/indonesia'] in the Bali listing with a direct /asia/bali anchor to avoid relying on the legacy redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: Mega-menu, drawer, search and homepage tiles share a single source of truth (destinationsData.js) which keeps Coming-soon handling consistent - good.
Legacy-redirect coverage for /asia/indonesia and its deep sub-routes works correctly.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (every critical acceptance criterion passes; only 2 LOW cosmetic issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Coming-soon/Bali/search/redirect/mosaic/mobile-drawer/static-asset requirements verified passing on preview URL. Two low-priority cosmetic leftovers remain: counter wording on Germany & Netherlands filtered pages, and one legacy /asia/indonesia anchor on the Bali listing (both harmless to UX because 4 cards still render and redirect still works).
